Window shades we offer

From a simple roller to folded Roman fabric, each shade handles light differently. Browse the styles, then check the light-control guide below.

Roller shades

A simple fabric panel that rolls up neatly. Available in light-filtering and room-darkening fabrics for bedrooms, living spaces, and offices.

Explore roller shades

Cellular shades

Honeycomb pockets trap air at the window. Single- and double-cell constructions offer different fabric and control options.

Explore cellular shades

Roman shades

Soft fabric gathers into folds as the shade rises. Patterns, textures, and linings determine the appearance and light control.

Explore Roman shades

Natural shades

Bamboo, grasses, and reeds bring texture to the window. The weave and optional liner determine how much light and privacy you get.

Explore natural shades

Solar shades

Screen fabrics help manage glare while retaining some outward view. The openness level affects the view; nighttime privacy needs a separate treatment.

Explore solar shades

Layered shades

Alternating sheer and solid bands let you adjust the light. Align the solid bands for more coverage or the sheer bands to let in light.

Explore layered shades

Pleated shades

Crisp folds give the window a light, tailored look. A single pleated fabric differs from the enclosed pockets of a cellular shade.

Explore pleated shades

Shade fabrics for
light and privacy

The fabric determines how much light passes through. The fit determines where light can enter around the edges. Both matter when choosing a shade.

Shade fabric options for daylight, bedroom darkening, and glare
What you needFabric to considerWhat to know
Soft daylightLight-filtering fabricSoftens sunlight. Privacy depends on the weave and the lighting inside and outside.
A darker bedroomBlackout fabric or linerBlocks light through the fabric. Gaps at the sides and mounting hardware can still let light in.
Less glare, some viewSolar screen fabricOpenness affects glare and the outward view. Solar screens do not provide dependable privacy at night.

Cordless and motorized shades

For tall windows or shades you adjust throughout the day, compare manual and motorized controls. We discuss power, access, and compatible remotes or smart-home options before ordering.

Available controls depend on the shade style, dimensions, and selected system.

Explore motorized shades

The right shade for the room

Color, texture, and your budget

Fabric texture, patterns, and linings change the appearance and price of a shade. Roller, pleated, cellular, and Roman styles offer different options. Motorization also affects your quote.

Kitchens and bathrooms

Think about humidity, splashes, and cleaning before choosing a fabric. Ask which materials are suitable near a sink or shower, and compare moisture-resistant blinds where a fabric shade may not be the right fit.

Large or unusual windows

For patio doors, skylights, arches, or angled windows, we check dimensions, access, and mounting space. The opening determines which shade styles and controls are practical.

Custom window shades installation in Fort Wayne

A good fit starts before the shade is ordered. We check the opening, mounting depth, and how you'll use each window.

Questions about custom shades

Questions about blackout fabrics, nighttime privacy, or shade repairs? Start here.

Call David at (260) 222-6467
How much do custom window shades cost?

The price depends on window size, fabric, style, liners, and controls. We compare options at different price points and prepare a quote for your project during the free consultation.

Are blackout shades completely dark?

Blackout fabric blocks light through the fabric, but light can enter around the edges or mounting hardware. We discuss fabric and installation options together, especially for bedrooms.

Do solar shades give privacy at night?

Do not rely on a solar screen for nighttime privacy. When the room is brighter than outside, people may be able to see in. Discuss a separate privacy treatment if that matters for your window.

Can I motorize my shades?

Motorization is available for selected shade styles and sizes. We check the product, power source, and control options for your windows before recommending a system.

What is the difference between cellular and pleated shades?

Cellular shades have enclosed honeycomb pockets. Pleated shades use folded fabric without that same cellular construction. Compare their light control, appearance, and insulating features in person.

Can you help with existing shades?

Yes. Contact us about shade repairs or cleaning. Tell us the type of shade and what needs attention so we can discuss the next step.
